detail: NSE archives record D. Ashok's filing of a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when an acquirer reaches specified shareholding thresholds. Substantive details (consideration, target shareholding %, timeline, structure, acquiring entity legal status) are not independently corroborated by available public sources.
